name: Harajuku and Takeshita Street

en.name: Harajuku and Takeshita Street
en.description: The global epicenter of youth fashion and modern pop culture, lined with colorful boutiques, crepe stands, and unique vintage shops. It offers a vibrant sensory experience drawing visitors from around the world.
en.notes: Explore local specialty food stalls and boutique shops at a relaxed pace.
en.reservation: No advance reservation required; tickets available on arrival.
en.parking: Commercial district paid parking garages available nearby.
